company_info.company_description: "Empower your home with Bradford SolarBradford Solar provides you with a choice of premium home batteries (including Tesla Powerwall), solar panels and inverters to suit your energy consumption, home configuration, lifestyle and budget. As one of Australia’s most trusted brands, we have built our reputation on excellence. We only use the highest quality, most efficient technology, and we back it all with expert technicians and our ‘Life of the system’ warranty. That’s why the biggest benefit that Bradford Solar offers you is complete peace of mind.The Bradford AdvantageBradford has been empowering Australian homes to be more energy efficient for over 80 years.Bradford Concierge Service from call to installTesla and Clean Energy Council Approved InstallersAustralia wide distribution networkPremium top tier solar energy products'Life of the system' warranty"

reviews.review_description: Do not purchase from this company. We paid for there 6.6kw system when building our new house. They installed a system that produces max 4.8kw. The inverter is only 5kw. I contacted Bradford's to have it fix and the response was ' it's just what we do'. Stay away.

Many customers have given good reviews.however, I have had not so good experience with this provider.Two of my batteries started not working after 5years of installations. they have 10 years warranty.It has been SIX months, the issue is still not resolved.Three parties keep blaming each other. Bradford, Solaredge and Tesla.I tried to contact the after sales technical service team manager to ask for quick resolution.Their team would not put me thru to the manager.I emailed them several times. No response.So I had to involve NSW Fair Trading.Once the person from Fair trading had a chat with Bradford I immediately received a phone call from them who never normally bothered to respond to my calls and emails.Funny that ha!!!And then I was given a time line as to when the resolution will be made. either fix the battery or get a refund.It is so sad from customer point of view that the Bradford are moving faster only after NSW Fair Trading was involved.

The service turnaround by Bradford is a disaster. After reporting a system fault, Bradford scheduled for a technician to visit us in 22 days time. My expectation for a tech visit is 3 or 4 days. Overall our system will not be generating power for over 1 month. When I called them they tell me there are no other techs to schedule earlier nor do they have any subcontractors. This is not acceptable and I warn others of such poor service.

Overall my experience with Bradford solar was good. After making the decision to expand my current solar setup I decided to expand and choosing Bradford solar was my first option. Quote and price was what I expected. Supply and install was faultless. Attention to detail and install was perfect. It wasn’t until after the install that I decided to check the warranty extension option with SolarEdge inverter. I realised that I wasn’t eligible with 9 yrs remaining of warranty. ( was supposed to the 12 ). After raising this with Bradford, SolarEdge ended up approving my warrant extension. My only issue/ concern was that my new solar install from Bradford included an inverter that was a ready 3 yrs old.Yes SolarEdge approved the warranty extension which was great but I didn’t expect to have a new inverter installed by Bradford energy that was already 3 yrs old. This was disappointing.

Would not recommend. So many issues. Would not issue bills. We paid out our solar straight away. Do not help resolve any issues. Would not give us our solar to change companies. After going to the ombudsman we finally got it. We are trying to get them to pay us the solar we missed out on for the past 3 months that they promised us and now saying we never paid the solar out. Even though it never bounced back and we are connect to another providerAbsolutely useless and no one there is helpful.
I wish I can swap this inverter for another better quality inverter under warranty.
Everything was done efficiently, punctual and supplied what we required.

Quoting process was very professional and lead time to install was ok at about 10 days.Installation team were very polite, tidy, and punctual.I think the installers were inexperienced with SMA inverters and they seemed to be feeling their way.Connection to the grid was ok but after 2 days the internet connection failed. The system itself is workingbecause I have been tracking it through my AGL account.I spoke to Customer Service about the failure after 2 days operation and was very disappointed to findthat it took over a week for a technician to come to my home to investigate.He arrived last Tuesday and was here for about one and a half hours then discovered that the inverter is faulty and needs to be replaced.He spoke with SMA and has ordered a replacement inverter.Disappointingly, I have not heard from Bradford CSR Customer Service since Tuesday.They move slowly to suite their system not their customers' satisfaction level.Fortunately, the system is working, and I am sure I have made the right decision to install solar.Unfortunately CSR seems more focused on their operations than really running the extra mile when a brand new, fully paid system fails to fully deliver.

The quote seemed to be the average. The installation, on roof was excellent. The electrician was a little untidy, noticed a few objects over the next few days.I had to ring AGL, they sent a smart meter connection letter.
Very professional and helpful from quoting to installation. Got it all installed and working in 3 weeks from accepting the quote.The installers(Go4Solar)did a very excellent job.Happy to recommend.

Quoting was easy called them and then got my quote within a few business days. There installers were awesome very friendly and polite happy to answer any questions I had, even let me go up their ladder to look at the solar panels! Had someone from the company come and do a check on the workers, make sure they were the right people installing. I felt really comfortable and safe they knew what they were doing! Made me feel confident Iâ€™d picked a great installer
Good post install support to help me get connected to the energy supplier
products were good but itâ€™s now August 2019 & itâ€™s been 8 months & theyâ€™re still avoiding to return to fix a roof leak problem that their installers created. Disgusting after sales service.

Bradford have changed their installer in SA, which I am glad about... the ones who initially installed whilst well meaning, used bad language for all the neighbours kids to hear, and left oil spots on my drive from dodgy vehicles, and were being continually harassed from their head office about time. It was a dangerous rainy day on the colourbond roof, and so... yes, it takes extra time not to plummet to your death. The new installers are much better, they did the replacement for my inverter, which had karked it after always being flaky.The customer service and after sales service are excellent. The salesmen always leave something to be desired, but to be honest, he was the best of a bad bunch. Something less of the snake oil flavour left lingering than most. Still not great. I find all the over-friendly, "hail-fellow-well-met" really off-putting. Personally I just want to get down to business with no questions about myself and my personal life. 'Showing an interest' in the customer as a person does not affect my rational purchase decision in any way, and comes off a little creepy, I'm afraid. That's all of them, though.We would probably have chosen another mob, but Bradford/CSR had the Tesla battery available, whereas I'd have had to wait 6 months with the others. Having said that, they performed well, and after installation service is EXCELLENT.

Yes,   I got a good company to do the job with good  quality materials . Thanks for your amazing advice, without them I could  never get this  excellent Solar Power System.  Hope other people follower your knowledge.
Bradford were very efficient and have an excellent support group
We went for Bradford as only one of your solar retailers gave us a quote out of the 3.

We ended up going with Bradford Solar because:1. They were to only company who took the time to come out and talk to us is person. (none of the solar quotes referrals did) Therefore they saw in person possible problems and individual needs that our site presented.2. There was no pressure to buy. All our questions were answered. The process and options were explained. They offered more than one brand of panels. We went with the better quality LG panels which none of the other referrals put in their quotes.3. They also included as standard the options which other installers added $500+ to the price.3. They were the only company which discussed the option of putting panels on three faces of our roof - which solar quotes itself mentions is an excellent way to go with falling feed in tarrifs.4. Their after sales warranty was by far the best we saw.5. Customer service throughout the process was excellent and our questions were answered promptly with nothing being too much trouble.6. The installation team were prompt, courteous, and excellent workers.
Awaiting some sort of reply from North Ryde. Been waiting 17 days since I first contacted them (now 2 August 2018). Nothing has been don to fix my system, which isn't working.
The installation was for Tesla battery, not solar panels.
Not installed yet
Knowledable supplier

Only two of your people quoted, that is even after I said that two only had contacted when your follow up contact was made. Neither of the two came to see me, but quoted me for panels shown on my neighbour's roof. I did not feel confident dealing with a computer to install Solar Panels on my roof, where as the CSR rep came out and quoted panels for my roof under my house's conditions. Thank You David Cook.

We had connections with builders, which entitled us to a family and friends discount.The salesman from the company you recommended did tell us that we had to have a minimum 5kW system on our roof because of the meter we had. We sought independent advice who told us this was not the case.

We started with the Representative, Christian. We have met other representatives for solar power and other systems but Christian didn't push the product down out throat - he simply explained everything which is exactly what we were after and he won our business because of his attitude and personality as well as his significant knowledge about his products.We actually purchased another natural air cooling system for our home through CSR (Bradford) so we have done quite a bit of business with them. They are highly recommended.The Installers were very professional too. They did a great job.
Not installed yet.

We put Bradford solar on our home. We are so delighted with their customer service and especially Steve. They answered all our questions straight away and delivered and installed the panels on time with no delays. The Bradford solar panels have been amazing. So thank you Steve and Bradford for everything. We will recommend your company and Steve to family and friends ????

The primary reason I selected this provider to install our solar was due to their close relationship with our builder, Metricon Homes (Qld) Pty Ltd. Unfortunately, our HIA building contract was signed after a promotion began to have solar (and a Tesla Powerwall 2) installed as part of the build, but thankfully, Bradford Solar were able to work with Metricon to have the installation roughed-in at Frame stage. Some assurances did come undone when we believed the system would be fully installed prior to handover (indications from Bradford Solar were that this was definitely to occur, and had been agreed to by Metricon), so that was disappointing, but otherwise the experience has been generally positive. We are confident that we have a good deal and that quality components are being used (Canadian Solar panels and Fronius Symo inverter).We await the completion of the system's installation around November 2017, when practical completion and handover ticks over.
The "elephant in the room" was getting a clear statement of the overall efficiency of a proposed system and hence the likely yearly output

Very responsive sales & pre-sales people - well detailed quotes and answered all questions comprehensively. Good quality materials (Canadian panels and Solaredge inverter with optimizers) and good quality installation. Installation co-ordination and communication through the installation process was less than ideal and is an area for improvement. Overall quite satisfied with the supplier/installer.

I had many questions, and they always happy to answer them. They were also prompt to call back or email. Although they were willing to price match, they had the best price anyway. The company has been around for about 100 years or more and is Australian so I feel like they will be reliable, and I think it is shown through their quote as well.

Bradford staff were easy to work with and provided infomation along the way. The installers were very good, hard working and cleaned up afterwards. They were also easy to talk to and very helpful when asked questions. After the installation they went through the operation of the system and explained the process regarding connection to the grid and said if I had any problems or wanted to know anything to give him a call.I would happily recommend Bradford solar to anyone thinking of installing solar panels.
We have used Bradford previously and the pre sale and after sales service was fantastic.

The installers were excellent and worked hard. The were knowledgeable and efficient.However, delivery of the panels did not occur on the installation day andthe installers had to come back the following week to finish.What really mattered in the end though was the quality of the work and this part was good.

We had both solar and hot water installed, the hot  water element has just broken after 18 months . Bradford installed a Hills tank , and I believe these tanks have not been made since January 2013. Pity they did not tell us when they quoted the job 18 months later. So we got a tank that is no longer made and is cheap. Bradford's answer to fix this, they will give us another tank and guess what it is a Hills so it must be at least 4 years old, but no they tell me it is new. They even tell me the spare parts suppliers are not doing a good job of finding spares. Suppling an out of date tank and then swapping it with another one just shows me they can't be trusted. Simple solution, Replace it with a new in production one.

Bradford was the only one of the 3 suppliers I had asked for a quote to come out to my property and check things first hand, and also to discuss all aspects in person.The process to actually start the work was somewhat drawn out (Christmas shutdown period came in between the date that I accepted the quote and when it was actually installed - almost 3 months before installation started).Installation had a few minor changes (mainly orientation of panels - nothing major), but otherwise went smoothly and was done in less than 2 days.The systems seems to be operating just fine - still waiting on the first bill to see what difference it makes.Overall a good experience.

You provided contact with two companies and contact to a third local company in order to keep your promise. One of your contacts never got in touch. The Bradford (CSR) rep was in touch and came and saw us very quickly with the local guys about a week behind. The locals were more thorough in their assessment of the property, roof and also in offering guidance and further tools to maximise our return form the solar, but they could not match CSR on price ($7.2K vs 12K on the same panels in a 5 kW system). The system was delivered, installation was arranged, but the installer never showed up. Another installer was lined up, who had to modify the panel arrangement, but got the job done and the system activated there and then.We went with price from a larger supplier, but the level of pre-installation checks, failure of an installer to show up and subsequent modification of the system were an inconvenience. If I was doing this again and money was less of an issues then I believe I would go with the local guys.

Bradford Solar were very professional throughout. No nonsense and not pushy. They offered a very good set up at a competitive price and being a subsidiary of CSR, a major Australian company, I felt they would be reliable in the event of something going wrong down the track. The installers (Toby Jansen of Laser Electrical ) were pleasant to deal with and the electrical inspector said that the installation was of the highest standard.

I was extremely happy with the whole process. It went smoothly and when I called the salesperson, Rory or the company, my questions were always answered immediately. The information on the solarquotes site were so informative and the videos helped us decide which products we wanted. You must compare apples with apples. We asked for a different inverter than what they normally supplied and this was not a problem. We chose suntech panels and an SMA inverter. We have 3 phase power and our price was the best for the products we got. Getting solar made me more aware of our usage as well as the rate we were paying. By changing retailers we calculated we would save $700 with the rate alone. We have only had it for 6 weeks so far and its fantastic to be able to see our daily generation on the inverter portal we have installed on our phone and desktop. We are from Box Hill in Victoria and July has been a pretty low month as there was not much sun. We produced 300 kwh. That's an average of 10 per day. i have been told that in the sunnier months it should be 3 times this amount.
These guys are professional, few hickups here and there but sorted out very professionally. From the date we signed up, 8 weeks to finish up and running including meter. Recommended by me.
Solar electricity panels installed as agreed but hot water system cancelled as quoted system not available anymore and available systems not suitable.
I chose Bradford CSR because their price was very good and they are a large well established company and will still be in business in the unlikely event of any future problem.
installed over 6 months ago but Energyaustralia still cannot get billing right.
I'm very pleased that once I'd made my decision, I didn't have to undergo any long waiting periods. From initial quote to installation was carried out promptly and professionally.

I am an older person with very limited knowledge of solar systems and I found your information very valuable, all the points you said to look out for Bradford, ticked all the right boxes.  Also the consultant that came was not only very polite he was also very helpful with the best location of the system with an inspection of the roof and direction of the sun etc., with pictures of my house roof taken at different hours of the day plus the equipment to read the sun's rays.

Quality of installation would have been good except that they forgot to replace 4 tiles that were removed from the roof leaving a gaping hole. Fortunately I noticed this before significant rain and managed to replace them myself. Bradford were very apologetic about this and offer to come and replace the tiles, but I had already done so.I investigated several other suppliers, but Bradford seemed to have the best system at a competitive price and offered the best warranty.
Nice, no pressure sales person. Prompt reply and inspection explained eveything in detail.
Bradford Solar go out of their way to make sure everything is as it should be.

The installers arrived in time, all four of them, worked fast, clean, without any damages, replaced broken tiles, explained how the system works, by 4 'o clock everybody left. The next morning, the group leader came back to check if everything is O.K. From the first contact to the installation took three weeks, including Christmas and New year.I would recommend this company to anyone.Now I wish that the connection to the grid, to be as quick and smooth  as  the installation was.
The service I received was excellent, everything was explained to me in terms that I could understand.
A person visited for face to face discussions and was most helpful and could answer questions 'on the spot'Other companies responded with emails, or not at all.
WE WANTED THE BEST, AND WE GOT THE BEST,FROM START TO FINISH.VERY HAPPY.WE GOT A 4 KW SYSTEM WITH A 5 KW INVERTER. BEST DECISION WE EVER MADE.
Generally speaking, good and experienced people.

My advice to people planning to install - you just cannot effectively plan solar panel array/s by satellite pictures alone.  It is theoretically possible but not advisable when you are going to spend lots of money and expecting good results.Bradford Solar is on the expensive side but you get what you paid for.  I was prepared to pay more for better service and better workmanship.I gave only a 3 on Customer service because the salesperson was not very responsive after the deal is signed.I gave installation the top score because they sacked the initial installer who was not very keen in his work and turned up smelling of alcohol under his breath (I didn't complain they picked it up).The replacement installers (two Tasmanian boys) were very reliable, takes pride in their work and virtually undo and redo what the previous installers had done - working till 7pm at night.A company that responds quickly and positively deserved to be recommended.  I would recommend Bradford Solar.
All company reps were competitive, friendly and generally helpful.I am particularly grateful for your simple and honest advice - thanks and keep up the good work.

Bradford were the first to respond to our enquiry and were very informative with no pressure.  Mark Group were next to respond and came to discuss the system. Seemed a very rehearsed sales pitch and pressured us to sign up there and then.  Asked for a formal written quote and the details of the exact system he was quoting to be sent to us, which he said he would do, but the written quote was never sent to us.  Didn't bother chasing it up as it didn't feel right with the Mark Group.  Infinite Energy emailed us (couple of weeks after our initial enquiry) and we told them about what we were looking for, then they called us for a quick discussion - said he would come out to us and give us a quote, but they never came and we didn't hear anything more from Infinite.Despite only receiving one written quote, we decided to go with Bradford, as they were very informative, panels and inverter were good quality, answered all our questions promptly and had great reviews on this website.System has been running for a week now and getting great numbers for a 5kw system (32.2 has been the best day so far and even that was a little bit cloudy in the morning).
Bradford provided the top of the range solar system on the market at time of installation for the most competitive price and, being local were on time with paper work and installation.
Bradford Solar were very professional and the unit was installed 5 days after signing the contract & they have followed up since. Good service.

The three companies you suggested for me all followed up with an email/phone contact. I also obtained a quote from another local company SAE, in the Tweed area who had been recommended to me.After reading as much as I could on your site Finn, prior to seeing any sales reps, I felt confident in making my decision as to who to go with. A great suggestion (given by Tim the guy from Bradford Solar whose quote I eventually went with) that also helped me know what size system would meet my needs best, was to read my meter for a week, every morning at 8.00am and every evening at 4pm, to see how much power I actually used during the day time. With the feed in tariff so low now, it's not cost effective to be producing more power than you actually can use in the daytime. Thus I have gone for a 1.5 kw system  (6  Suntech 250W polycrystalline panels with a Power-One Aurora 2000W inverter which they gave me a 10 year warranty on) Very pleased.Installed  just a week ago. No hassles whatsoever. Making plenty of kWs already. Thanks for a great site Finn.

Very honest sales approach. The only salesman who actually went to the trouble of explaining the true usage and value proposition around size of system.The first guy from another company simply talked about the size system that we could fit on our north facing roof and recommended a bigger system than we needed!The other had us using panels that were not highly recommended and a lessor inverter but at uch cheaper price. We decided on CSR due to a quality product underwritten by an Australian public Company for 25 years.

Bradford CSR were good overall,the sales girl Gemma had a good attitude, not pushy at all, she went outside and actually looked at the roof and meterbox (others didn't).Also they were willing to negotiate a little bit on extended warranty price and chucked in an LED downlight.The installers were on time,even though it was raining they just got on with it and they only took 4 hours to install and were happy to put the inverter in my garage.On a side note, Solar Harness came and quoted and were shocking, the salesman called Tony wasn't even interested in assessing my roof or meter box,told me 3 or 4 marvelous claims from the word go that i knew were lies,and within 5 minutes came up with a price of $6000,that was almost double my other quote. When i told him it was out of my budget he then dropped the price $2000 immediately.He seemed to be not very knowledgeable of solar, and was a bit rude when I asked him questions he didnt like and he said quite rudely "You don't believe me do you?"He left soon after that and I didn't get any follow up call from them not surprisingly.So Bradford CSR were good.Solar Harness = Beware of.  In my opinion.

Had a minor problem with the alignment of some of the panels but nothing was too much trouble.Just waiting on Energex to change my meter then will be up and running I am also very confident if I have any issues or problems in the future that Bradford Solar will fix it without delay.I have exceptional customer service and would recommend them to friends and family

Bradford Solar were good from start to finish.Sales consultant Ralph Gwynne well informed, and readily answered all queries. He was not pushy. He checked our site thoroughly including the sun eye meter to estimate the sunlight exposure throughout the year. We decided on a 4.5 kWh system - 18x250W suntec panels and 5kw Aurora Inverter.Bradford office staff Danielle Brandon was very prompt and helpful as well. Installation happened on time, and the installation guys were very good and finished the job very neatly and professionally.Inspection happened about a week later. Inspector was very pleased with the installation. Pleasant surprise was that he (Inspector) informed us that our smart meter was already configured and the system could be left turned on to produce electricity. So we have been getting solar electricity from about eight days after the installation.We have not received any word from our retailer or wholesaler regarding completion of formalities from their side.Have been checking the meter which shows the export and import of electricity at different times of the day. In 14 days the system has produced 179 kWh (av.12.79kWh per day - lowest 7.3 kWh and highest 22.6kWh)Bradford solar were very good, as such I would not hesitate in recommending them to any one interested.Thanks also to you Finn for providing such a valuable service. I am impressed.

I have been trying to make an informed decision on solar for a long time now and with all the offers out there promoting that "their product has won some award so must be the best".Tim from Bradford had the information I needed and asked me to do things such as check our electricity output on a daily basis so we could get a system that was right for us. He was in no way pushy and gave us more than ample time to make a decision. He directed us to independent web sites for reviews on solar companies/installers which made the difference when we had finally narrowed it down to 3.The install is occurring today but so far I am very happy with my decision.
It's too early yet to tell anything about the quality of the installation or the quality of the inverters/panels.
Mark group sales person very unethical!

Solar Quotes and Finn helped giving me an idea what to look for in regards to a system, explaining everything on his website in easy understanding terms.Being a car guy and comparing inverters to cars was easier for me to understand. The panels could have more information though. I asked questions from Solar Quotes and got a quick reply.It's a credit to Finn and well done, before I got onto the website I knew nothing about solar and though it was a bit of a scam.
Value for money very good. Salesman was good. Great polite installation team, however, installed wronginverter! Still waiting on them to get back to me on when they will rectify!

Bradford was the only company whose representative bothered to climb up onto the roof and have a good look around. Even my wife liked him. He was very good on the technical details and as I am of a scientific training I could tell if I was be bullshitted too.Have had a few issues with installation due to inclement weather, but I hope to have it up and running next week.Your website was very informative and helpful.

Not the cheapest but with Bradford covering warranty and not relying on manufactures warranty, I felt that if there was a problem with any component it would be covered. This was even with the supplier going out of business.Not sure how it is going as network provider has not done meter upgrade, but I did get it in time for 44cents rebate etc.Sunny day peaked at 5010 watts.

Excellent experience with Bradford. Knowledgeable and direct.It's a very competitive market as we all know and Bradford stood apart from the others for the fact that they let their own offerings do the talking and didn't waste my time on telling me what was wrong with the competition.Very happy with the system and performing better than expected. Recommended highly.

We did go ahead with one of the quotes that we received through your website, namely the one from Bradford Solar, and the system has now been installed for a month.It is a 3.5KW, 14x250W SunTech monocrystaline + 5KW Aurora inverter with the panel array split into 2 north facing areas of 7 panels each; the mountings are stainless steel. On very good days, i.e sunny and not very hot, we had a peak of 4KW, so I would say the system is performing quite well. If I'm not mistaken, on a sunny day, the system would produce about 20KWh in total.As far as I can tell the installeres did a good job and we only had a couple of cracked tiles. It took two people a day's work to complete it.It is probably not the best quality system, but not far from it either. The inverter is well from a established brand, quite popular in Europe I understand, with good reviews, and it has been assembled in US, while the panels, though made in China, come from a well known supplier and have very good specifications.
Sales person very good, installer excellent. Have been waiting 5 weeks for inspector to check system. Grid connect?
Can't give you an answer to the above 4 x questions as installation has not taken place as yet.
It is hard to give ratings about the quality of the system in terms of how efficient it may be as we have only had it working for 8 days!
Prompt, no pressure, information at my level, great follow up. Trades were polite, efficient, tidy and punctual.

I found the experience with Bradford to be very good - the salesperson was not pushy and was upfront with all information (did not hide or exaggerate anything).  The installers were Bradford employees (not subcontractors) and were very good with no fuss and very tidy.  I could not be any happier with the solar we installed.

Company has backing of CSR, salesman (Jim) is not on commission so was not pushy but was helpful and informative. Decided on Suntech panels & Aurora Inverter for under $5k. Installation scheduled with in next 4 weeks. Accept deposit and final payment with credit card and no fees.
It appeared that once we paid the deposit we were only a number.contact 1 -- to tell us our system will be installed after Christmas.contact 2 -- day before install one week later no follow up.

System was actually 3.5 kW comprising 14 x 250 w panels which are all placed on our north-east facing roof. (Suntech Monocrystallline Panels and a 5000 w Power One Aurora Inverter). Has produced around 500 kWh in four weeks.Company Rep. was informative and answered all our questions. I favoured the Reps who actually visited the site rather than those that relied on Google or similar computer images to provide quotes.One minor negative is that the manual for the Inverter is all technical stuff and there is no explanation of the display panel readings.
As the system has not yet been installed the quality of system, installation and customer service (other than the excellent service in relation to giving us a quote) cannot be rated yet.
Bradford were very patient with me whilst I took 6 months to decide. They helped me all along the way, so that once I decided what I wanted, there was no reason why I would go anywhere else.

The reports and information on the SolarQuotes web site were very useful, it gave me a place to start from and acted as a good reference check when talking with suppliers. The ability to also select three people to provide me with quotes and have them call me was also most useful.

We installed 2.5kW instead of 3kW system because we were limited on roof space. Only Bradford got on the roof to check. One quoted for 3kW from the ground. One quoted by google earth without visiting the site. So we were just more confident in the person who checked our roof. The installation was well done. The product quality was middle of the road according to my web searches. The winning quote was competitive with a royalty to UNSW on the panels, a nice touch.

5 kW Inverter / 3.5 kW solar panels installed.Proposal is to try the 3.5 kW system for a few months and then decide on adding additional panels.I experienced a significant delay after the panels and inverter were installed before the power meter was replaced and the sytem turned on.  Endeavour Energy had "run out of the meters".

System has been installed, all cirtificates are done and forwarded on.Now waiting for Energy Aust to reprogram the smart meter for feeding power in.**Very important, you can't turn on your solar till the not so smart meter has been re-programmed****The meter counts forward from feed in and can run your bill up and no way to work out how much so you will be expected to pay**Bradford Solar guys were completely upfront with this info and got it confirmed from 2 other sources since; so solar is off till sorted.The Bradford installers were very professional, knew what they were doing, had all the safety gear required and were very easy to get along with so the install cruised along without an issue.
Fantastic installation process, connected to the grid 23rd of October.
Bradford weren't in a hurry for a deposit, the others that come here wanted it on the day. Overall the cost was not much more to smaller systems with poor reviews.

our 2kW system with Aurora inverter became faulty just after 3 months. It has produced 30 kWh instead of around 900kWh. Contacted Bradford Solar warranty- technician came after 1 week and numerous phone calls. Technician 1 hour late.

Very good service and punctual.  Pity you have to wait for the supplier (up to 8 weeks) to get the thing up and running.  I thought we were trying to conserve energy and reduce the green house effect.  We can pay the carbon tax but try and get your solar connected to the grid, good luck.

Whole experience with Bradford Solar in Melbourne was excellent. From Ralph the salesman, Damian the installation contact and the team that did the installation, I could not fault them. The installation was very neat, and the crew cleaned up their mess and replaced a couple of broken roof tiles for me. I would highly recommend at least getting a quote from Bradford Solar if you are looking at getting solar panels.
Professional in their communication and service.
Very good experience with Bradford, quick follow up before and after installation.

Re Customer Service. To be fair, there were some communications problems caused by staffing difficulties at the local Bradford branch, but the manager, Trevor Rossiter, really went out of his way to sort things out, even to the extent of returning to work during his Christmas leave to ensure that our installation went ahead smoothly.It's now just 30 days since the system was commissioned and so far there have been no problems whatsoever. A brief summary of performance may be of interest:Period: 11.30 am  on 21/12/11 to 11.30 am on 20/01/12.System: 8 x 190W Suntech panels feeding Aurora 2000 transformerless inverter. Panels face almost due north; tilt angle approx 22 degrees.Total kilowatt hours generated in 30 days = 269; average production per day = 8.957 kWh.Total hours connected to grid 407. Average hourly production = 661WTotal kWh exported to grid = 171.  (Yes, we are pretty economical power users!)Peak instantaneous production noted (Pac) was 1.617 kW in full sun at ambient temp of about 25 deg C. This equates to a DC input of about 1.7 kW, demonstrating that the panels more than meet their specs.Actual cost to us of installation: $3226   (System cost $2990 plus $236 to Synergy for bi directional meter and REBS).While it's too early to see what the true effect on our power bills will be, I think I can confidently predict a substantial drop. Against that, I have to say that without the government subsidies I doubt that solar PV system are cost effective. The moral, of course, is get in while you still can!.
